name: Amber Royale
tagline: The warmth of ancient bazaars at dusk
scent_story: Amber Royale opens like a lantern lit in the golden hour — saffron and spice curling through warm stone corridors. At its heart, ancient amber and rose bloom with quiet authority. What lingers is the memory of incense and cedar, long after you've left the room.

theme.overlay_mood: Warm coral-red radial glow, deep dark-red background.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.body: Amber Royale is everything I didn't know I needed. The oud is rich but not overpowering, and the saffron opening is pure luxury. This is what Indian perfumery should be.

reviews.author: Rahul M.
reviews.body: Got compliments all evening at a wedding. Genuinely world-class quality at an Indian price point. Ordered two more as gifts.

reviews.author: Anjali K.
reviews.body: Beautiful scent, great longevity. The amber heart is warm without being heavy. Will be ordering again.

name: Frosted Air
tagline: Clarity at altitude. Cold air, open sky.
scent_story: Frosted Air is what the Himalayas smell like at 6am — sharp, alive, and impossibly clear. A crystalline opening of yuzu and mint gives way to soft iris, before settling into the quiet warmth of cedar and white musk.

theme.overlay_mood: Crystal icy blue radial glow, deep dark-blue-black background.

reviews.author: Kavita A.
reviews.body: Perfect for summer mornings. The yuzu and mint opening is incredibly refreshing without being sharp. Lasts well into the afternoon.

reviews.author: Arjun S.
reviews.body: Finally a fresh fragrance that doesn't smell synthetic. The cedarwood base is what makes this — gives it real depth.

name: Noir Floral
tagline: Flowers that only bloom after midnight.
scent_story: Noir Floral begins in shadow and blooms in candlelight. A bouquet that feels familiar yet refuses to be placed — black rose and tuberose with depth borrowed from patchouli and benzoin. Neither sweet nor sharp. Just unforgettable.

theme.overlay_mood: Deep rose-pink radial glow on a near-black background.

reviews.author: Sunita T.
reviews.body: The black rose accord is unlike anything I've smelled in an Indian brand. Dark, complex, and deeply elegant. This is my new evening fragrance.

reviews.author: Meera R.
reviews.body: The patchouli base keeps it grounded. Not a typical sweet floral at all — it has real character and incredible projection.

name: Oud Signature
tagline: The scent of ceremony. Deep, ancient, unmistakable.
scent_story: Oud Signature is not a fragrance that announces itself — it arrives. A deep, ceremonial opening of raw oud and frankincense, tempered by the softness of rose and amber. On the skin, it becomes something entirely personal: ancient, meditative, and yours.

theme.overlay_mood: Rich antique gold radial glow on deepest near-black background.

reviews.author: Vikram P.
reviews.body: The finest oud fragrance from an Indian house I've tried. The smokiness is there but it's restrained — this smells like a private ceremony, not a marketplace.

reviews.author: Deepa N.
reviews.body: Bought this as a wedding gift. The rose and leather in the heart notes give it a gravitas that makes it feel like a true luxury.

name: Woody Intense
tagline: Forest floor after rain. Grounded and alive.
scent_story: Woody Intense is a walk through pine forests at dusk — not a romanticised version, the real thing. Sharp conifer and black pepper give way to deep cedar and vetiver, finishing on a base that feels like soil, moss, and open mountain air.

theme.overlay_mood: Forest green radial glow on deep near-black background.

reviews.author: Rohit D.
reviews.body: This is my new signature. The pine and pepper opening is bracing, then it settles into the most beautiful cedar vetiver heart. Incredible sillage.

reviews.author: Gaurav S.
reviews.body: The oakmoss base is what sets this apart from everything else in the Indian market. Deep, real, and long-lasting. Highly recommend for men.
